controls.name: Work-time threshold exception
controls.obligation: Manage fatigue risk and work/rest compliance for fatigue-regulated heavy vehicle activity.
controls.risk: Driver operates while fatigued or outside configured work/rest controls.
controls.evidence: EWD/work diary, roster, trip schedule, training, override record

controls.evidence: Supplier profile, contracts, certificates, attestations, shared assurance status, findings
controls.test_logic: Supplier has open high-risk finding beyond tolerance.
controls.remediation_template: Request evidence; restrict work allocation if needed; update passport; escalate unresolved supplier risk
controls.applicability_notes: Determined by jurisdiction, activity, CoR role, vehicle type, operating model and accreditation status.
